main_issue: The mechanism is coherent and well-supported by the reviewed evidence: source (artifact download resource serving uploaded files), sink (Content-Type header derived from ContentDetector on attacker-controlled bytes), missing guard (no nosniff, no forced inert type), exploit precondition (attacker uploads HTML/JS, victim opens link), and safe fix (octet-stream + nosniff) all align cleanly. The single representative case (CVE-2022-39207) is sufficient to establish the mechanism, but the boundary family has only one confirmed member, which limits cross-case coherence validation.
